She explains that after rapid growth to over 1,000 locations fueled by weekly rotating cookies and social media virality, the chain began closing at least 60 stores amid plunging traffic and franchisee struggles, including one filing for Chapter 7 bankruptcy. description: A young man in a home kitchen demonstrates how to make 'two ingredient watermelon jello.' He starts by slicing a large watermelon in half, commenting on its juiciness, then levels off one half so it stands upright. He scoops out all the red flesh, places it in a blender, and blends until smooth. After straining the puree through a sieve to remove pulp, he measures about six cups of juice. In a separate bowl, he blooms five packets of gelatin in cold water. He warms a small amount of the watermelon juice on a portable burner, dissolves the bloomed gelatin into it, then combines that mixture with the remaining juice. He pours the liquid back into the hollowed-out watermelon shell, refrigerates it for 6 to 8 hours to set, then removes it and cuts it into triangular wedges. The final product wobbles like jello but retains the shape and rind of a watermelon slice, which he holds up and tastes, confirming it is 'actually jiggly.' The video alternates between close-ups of the process and the creator's expressive reactions.
